plans.idea: Centered poster stack: the headline becomes a huge centered statement in the upper-middle with the pill CTA directly below on the same center axis, so the eye goes from message to action in one vertical read.
Left-aligned editorial: a large two-line headline hugs the left margin and the CTA sits under it on the same left edge, leaving deliberate open purple space on the right as the brand-colour field.

Scaled-up banner that keeps the original's left-to-right structure: big headline on the left half and the CTA on the right, both centred on one horizontal axis, faithful to the source but sized for the landscape canvas.
